tidymodels_prefer()
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

# suppress "`summarise()` has grouped output by " messages
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

```{r load-other-packages}

}

```

```{r tbl-table1}

analysis |>
  tbl_summary(
    include = c(everything()), # choose your variables here
    # change auto_man to your column variable or delete by = auto_man
    by = auto_man, # split table by group
    missing = "no" # don't list missing data separately
  ) |>
  # add_n() |> # add column with total number of non-missing observations
  # add_p() |> # test for a difference between groups
  modify_header(label = "") |> # update the column header to be blank
  bold_labels()
```

# References {.unnumbered}

```{r make-references}
#| include: false

# automatically create a bib database for loaded R packages & rUM
bib_pkgs <- c(.packages(), "rUM")
if (file.exists("bib/packages.bib")) {
  old_pkgs <- stringr::str_match(
    readLines("bib/packages.bib", warn = FALSE),
    "^@Manual[{]R-([^,]+),"
  )[, 2]
  old_pkgs <- stats::na.omit(old_pkgs)
  old_pkgs <- old_pkgs[
    vapply(old_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  ]
  bib_pkgs <- unique(c(bib_pkgs, old_pkgs))
}
knitr::write_bib(bib_pkgs, "bib/packages.bib")
```
